entities.name: Marie of Blois, Duchess of Anjou
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marie of Blois (1345–1404) was the daughter of Joan of Penthièvre, Duchess of Brittany and Charles of Blois, Duke of Brittany. Through her marriage to Louis I, Duke of Anjou, she became Duchess of Anjou, Countess of Maine, Duchess of Touraine, titular Queen of Naples and Jerusalem and Countess of Provence.
